Monica —

Quick heads up: during vendor load-in the north main truss took a partial rip near bay C. No injuries, but several overhead fixtures have shifted and a couple of DMX power drops tripped. We isolated the circuit but two things are immediate:

- Structural: rigging company recommends temporary shoring before we resume load-in.
- Power: an RJ-45 surge / distro is compromised near the truss — some booth circuits lost power.

I attached photos (venue_truss_photos.jpg). Our in-house crew can do a short-term strap but we recommend your approved rigger for a proper repair. We can also run an alternate distro to the nearby motor-access point but that will take ~45–60 min.

We can provision a 4G bonded router immediately and have a Starlink unit on standby if you want full redundancy; we can quote and deliver in ~90 min.

Please advise on contractor + generator access. We’ll keep Stage A closed to load-in until the shoring is in place.

—Marco
